title: A postcard from your holiday
context_es: Estás de vacaciones junto al mar. Escribes una postal a tu amiga inglesa, Emma.
prompt_en: You are on holiday. Write a postcard to your friend Emma.
useful_language: The weather is sunny / hot / cold.
tips_es: Una postal es corta: tres o cuatro frases bastan.
Para lo que haces estos días, presente simple con *every day* o *in the morning*.
model_answer:
Dear Emma,

I am in Cádiz with my family. The weather is hot and sunny. Every day we go to the beach in the morning and we eat fish in a small restaurant. The town is very nice.

See you soon!
Love,
Pablo
